problem: Applications lacked one semantic transaction across existing GUI pointer, keyboard, regional hit testing and preview lifetimes.
method: One private drag controller reuses the existing input domain, coordinates, focus actions and renderer resource owners; ordinary controls allocate no dormant drag slots.
conclusion: Original G09 runtime and production composition verified. Public named admission and final package/device/performance qualification remain with G13; original failures and budgets remain.

usage.binding: Attach structural dragSource/dropTarget options or setDragSource/setDropTarget to ordinary GUI elements. Read/cancel GuiSystem.dragSession.
usage.payload: getData returns application-owned unknown data; canDrop/drop receive the same reference and target-local logical coordinates.
usage.preview: Optional factory returns an unattached GUI subtree; disposePreview runs after detach. Regional apps provide a topmost full-canvas GUI overlay for previews; data-only dragging does not require it.
usage.input: Mouse or touch uses six CSS pixels. Auto touch preserves vertical scrolling; touchGesture drag explicitly owns a dedicated handle. Existing confirm/next/previous/direction/cancel UI actions provide keyboard equivalence.
usage.cleanup: Synchronous callbacks; end is exactly once. Throwing drop is attempted once and reports accepted false; Engine does not roll back business side effects. Do not retain payloads/resources in application callbacks unnecessarily.
usage.serialization: Protocols, payloads, previews and live sessions are runtime-only; rebind through application IDs after loading. GUI v1 remains unchanged.
